FN-HK0068-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 238
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Wes Kitchens
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/11/2023
House Bill 238 as introduced authorizes the issuance of a distinctive motor vehicle license plate
to benefit brain cancer research. The fee for the license plate would be the same as for standard
vehicles ($23) with an additional annual fee of $50. The standard fee would be distributed as
follows:
State General Fund $10.00
Public Road and Bridge Fund $ 9.30
Municipalities $ 2.52
Counties: $ 1.18
Total $23.00
The additional $50 annual fee would be distributed as follows:
2.5% Commission to License Plate Issuing Official $ 1.25
Department of Corrections $ 1.50
Department of Revenue-Administrative Cost $ 1.00
Department of Senior Services $ 5.00
Blazer Bolt, Incorporated $41.25
Total $50.00
Page 1
